limitations: Orbital energy transfer does not measure radial or vertical random velocity dispersion or stellar survival.
Guiding-radius cohort is not an instantaneous spatial cohort and is not co-spatial with the halo binding tag.
No finite halo/star ratio, universal feedback bound, self-consistent core or observational exclusion is inferred.
Monte Carlo standard errors and delta-method ratios are sample estimates, without finite-sample tail coverage certification.
The spherical prescribed field includes no live disk, hydrodynamics, star formation or bar response.
